title: The Map of Stars
author: Barış Kısır
premise: The old observatory\'s map of stars is wrong — the constellations have moved, and teenage astronomer Juno is the only one who noticed. When she redraws the map, the stars begin answering: a pattern emerges that is not astronomy but a message, and it is addressed to her.
